page.overview:
Who is Umman Kudu?

Umman Kudu was a former Captain of Baron Vladimir Harkonnen's personal guard. He served in Siege of Arrakeen. Kudu had a scissorsline of jaw muscles and a chin like a boot toe. He died in Leto Atreides I's poisoned tooth attack. He was replaced by former Harkonnen Guard Corporal Iakin Nefud.
